description: THE DOCUMENT ITSELF, by the name qa_reports lists. Pass `out` to write it to a file — which is almost always what you want, because a self-contained report carries its pictures as data and spending that through this conversation buys nothing. Without `out` the HTML comes back inline. Read-only: it takes a copy and leaves the extension’s own untouched.

out.description: Write the HTML here instead of returning it inline
